ch11_p10_chk1_solo.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk1_solo.text: Active Checkpoint 1: A medical imaging pipeline ingests twelve thousand radiographs per hour, escalating ten percent to fifteen certified radiologists who take forty-five minutes per case. What is the Tier 3 queue utilization rho and operational consequence? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk1_duo.speaker: Kaito
ch11_p10_chk1_duo.text: Checkpoint 1! Twelve thousand incoming radiographs per hour, ten percent escalated to fifteen radiologists each taking forty-five minutes per case. What is the queue utilization rho and operational consequence? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk1_feedback_correct.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk1_feedback_correct.text: Brilliant queuing analysis! Option B is correct. Tier 3 receives ten percent of twelve thousand scans, which is twelve hundred cases per hour. But fifteen radiologists each completing four-thirds of a case per hour have a combined capacity of only twenty cases per hour! Thus rho equals sixty point zero, causing an immediate unbounded backlog explosion. The engineering remedy requires tuning triage thresholds to lower expert escalation to under zero point one six percent.

ch11_p10_chk1_feedback_incorrect.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk1_feedback_incorrect.text: Incorrect. Review the queuing stability equation: utilization rho equals arrival rate lambda divided by service capacity mu. Ten percent of twelve thousand incoming scans is twelve hundred cases per hour. Fifteen radiologists each taking forty-five minutes can only process twenty cases per hour. Thus rho equals twelve hundred divided by twenty, which is sixty point zero! Arrival rate exceeds capacity by sixty times, causing an immediate backlog explosion. The correct answer is Option B.

ch11_p10_sim2_duo.speaker: Kaito

ch11_p10_chk2_solo.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk2_solo.text: Active Checkpoint 2: When merging fifteen thousand newly labeled examples into your master production training corpus, which trio of automated Data CI/CD gates must execute before triggering model deployment? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk2_duo.speaker: Kaito
ch11_p10_chk2_duo.text: Checkpoint 2! What trio of automated Data CI/CD regression gates must execute before merging new hybrid labels into the golden production dataset? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk2_feedback_correct.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk2_feedback_correct.text: Spot on DataOps mastery! Option B is correct. Production pipelines must enforce schema nullability and distribution KL-divergence invariants, run Confident Learning out-of-fold label noise audits with Cohen's Kappa above zero point eight two, and evaluate retrained weights against immutable golden master test slices with zero tolerance for safety regressions.

ch11_p10_chk2_feedback_incorrect.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk2_feedback_incorrect.text: Incorrect. Option B is correct. Manual inspection of fifteen thousand examples is cost-prohibitive, and retraining from scratch wastes compute. Production pipelines enforce schema nullability and distribution KL-divergence invariants, Confident Learning label noise audits with Kappa above zero point eight two, and zero regression gates on immutable golden evaluation slices.

ch11_p10_chk3_solo.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk3_solo.text: Active Checkpoint 3: An autonomous vehicle perception team processes one hundred thousand camera frames daily. Tier 1 costs a tenth of a cent, Tier 2 costs ten cents, and Tier 3 costs twenty-five dollars. The cascade absorbs seventy-five percent at Tier 1, fourteen percent at Tier 2, and eleven percent at Tier 3. What is the average unit cost and total budget savings versus a pure expert baseline? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk3_duo.speaker: Kaito
ch11_p10_chk3_duo.text: Final checkpoint of Track 11! One hundred thousand daily frames processed across a three-tier cascade with seventy-five percent Tier 1, fourteen percent Tier 2, and eleven percent Tier 3. What is the unit cost and total budget savings versus a pure expert baseline? Choose Option A, B, C, or D above me!

ch11_p10_chk3_feedback_correct.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk3_feedback_correct.text: Outstanding mathematical derivation! Option C is correct. Expected unit cost equals zero point zero zero one plus zero point two five times zero point one zero plus zero point one one times twenty-five dollars, which equals exactly two dollars and seventy-seven point six cents per item. For one hundred thousand items, total daily expenditure is two hundred and seventy-seven thousand six hundred dollars, compared to two point five million dollars for pure expert review—delivering an eighty-eight point nine percent budget savings!

ch11_p10_chk3_feedback_incorrect.speaker: Dr. Nova
ch11_p10_chk3_feedback_incorrect.text: Incorrect. Review the expected cost equation: unit cost equals c1 plus probability of reaching Tier 2 times c2, plus probability of reaching Tier 3 times c3. That evaluates to zero point zero zero one plus zero point two five times zero point one zero, plus zero point one one times twenty-five dollars, yielding two dollars and seventy-seven point six cents per item. That achieves an eighty-eight point nine percent budget savings over twenty-five dollars. The correct answer is Option C.
